external_entities.name: Members
external_entities.description: People who use the loyalty programme, mobile app, and partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: Members' phones
external_entities.description: Phones on which members use the mobile app and where mobile refresh tokens are kept.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

external_entities.name: Member browser
external_entities.description: A member's browser used for authorization server sign-in, consent, and redirect handling.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

external_entities.name: Partner apps
external_entities.description: Web applications run by other companies on their own servers, including applications that show a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: Mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application used by members to sign in and call the rewards API.

processes.name: Authorization server
processes.description: The server that signs members in, handles authorization and consent, and issues tokens.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: Rewards API
processes.description: The API called by the mobile app and partner apps, which reads and writes points and logs requests.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

processes.name: Support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: Identity database
data_stores.description: Database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: Points ledger
data_stores.description: Ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction, including the client that made each change.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.description: Members use the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

data_flows.name: store refresh token
data_flows.description: The mobile app keeps a refresh token on the member's phone.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

data_flows.name: call rewards API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back.
data_flows.data_description: access token and loyalty rewards requests

data_flows.name: use browser
data_flows.description: A member uses a browser for authorization server sign-in and consent.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

data_flows.name: sign in and consent
data_flows.description: The member's browser accesses the authorization server sign-in page and consent screen.
data_flows.source_excerpt: signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen
data_flows.data_description: sign-in credentials, consent, and requested scopes

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.description: The browser returns to a partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: request tokens
data_flows.description: A partner app sends its client secret in the body of token requests.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.data_description: client ID, client secret, and authorization code

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: A partner app uses the partner API to show a member's points.
data_flows.source_excerpt: such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores accounts, credentials, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: update points ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write API requests
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes every received request, including headers, to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: obtain access tokens
data_flows.description: The support console takes access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

trust_boundaries.name: Own cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud account in which the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: Members' phones
trust_boundaries.description: Members' phones, which are outside the organisation's cloud account.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: apart from the members' phones and the partner apps.

trust_boundaries.name: Partner apps' own servers
trust_boundaries.description: Servers owned or operated by other companies for their partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers
